title: Quota-aware scheduling: capture reset times and defer instead of silently escalating
observation: FAIL-0001: during the bootstrap both the Claude session limit and the Codex usage limit were hit. Adapters classify `quota` and the engine fails over, but reset times are discarded, so cheap routes disappear and work shifts to pricier ones.
suggested_direction: Parse reset/Retry-After hints from provider errors into a machine-local provider availability record with an expiry; router treats the provider as unavailable until then; delegate and runs may defer low-priority cheap work instead of escalating tier.
acceptance: A quota failure records the provider's reset time when present
Router skips the provider until the reset time, then re-probes
Escalation to a stronger tier because of quota is recorded as such in telemetry
